integrity: The proof is analytic. Packaged symbolic checks verify the Lyapunov and defect identities exactly. A finite numerical trajectory was used only as a stress test and is not evidence for the infinite-time claim.
limitations: Exact-threshold asymptotics only; the claimed rate is for interior data with positive initial bullying level. No finite-time error bound is asserted. Generic transcritical theory makes algebraic slowing plausible, so the source-specific exact constants and logarithmic correction are the substantive contribution.
title: Sharp logarithmic critical relaxation at the bullying-index threshold
